signal: LiveSwitch is bootstrapped at ~$7.8M ARR, growing its LiveSwitch Contact virtual-estimate product for field-service businesses

email.body1:
Connor, saw LiveSwitch is scaling LiveSwitch Contact for field-service teams while staying bootstrapped at around $7.8M ARR.

Growing efficiently like that means every rep has to cover more accounts than they can realistically touch, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for LiveSwitch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Connor, quick follow-up for LiveSwitch.

When you're growing without outside capital, every hire has to pay for itself, so the team can rarely afford the SDR coverage the number actually requires. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings LiveSwitch needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Connor, last bit of proof for LiveSwitch.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how LiveSwitch's reply rate likely compares to other bootstrapped SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Connor, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running lean and growing is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a lean SaaS motion? I'll tailor it to LiveSwitch either way.
